name: Verisleight
what: truth arranged to mislead — every word true, the picture false
affordance: deniability: the false picture is installed by the hearer's own inference, so the speaker asserted nothing false
mechanism: violates Grice's maxims of Quantity/Relation while observing Quality — misleading via implicature rather than assertion. Channel: implicated (cancellable; does not project under negation).
benign_reading: Selective emphasis is normal speech; every answer curates. The tell is a direct question answered with a curated truth that predictably paints a false picture.
output_phrasing: this statement is literally true and arranged to imply more than it says

naming_events.source: al-Jurjānī, Dalā'il al-I'jāz — three-type taxonomy of deniable implicature, 'more eloquent than plain statement' because deniable
